message: サクッと片づけちゃって

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Look at all those shooting stars」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if it's because Re-Crea is getting close」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know, we're gonna win」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」
Nanaka is right here beside me.
As long as she is, everything is bound to go well. We can even save the world. That's how it feels.

name: Nanaka
message: 「During the Holy Night Festival, come check out my club's attraction on your break」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. It's a maid cafe, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I skipped out on prep yesterday, so Sacchin's probably gonna chew me out」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're talking about that, I ditched prep for the whole Holy Night Festival」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Worst Student Council President ever!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't act all high and mighty when you're the reason why」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, you see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm actually the Demon Lord」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uhh... what's that supposed to mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm telling the truth here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. That joke's not really landing」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be a problem if you got freaked out when Re-Crea hits, so I'm telling you now」

name: Paqy
message: 「And yours truly is the Demon Lord's familiar. The Great Sage Paqy himself」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...When you say it like that, Paqy, it sounds even more like a joke」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kuha!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be bad if I'm worn out when it counts, so I won't transform right now. I'm the Demon Lord, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then hey. Give me the world」

name: Synn
message: 「Specifically?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Make all the sweets in the world mine!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a little impossible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. I wouldn't ask you for something like that, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Something you can do even without being the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. What could that be」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's a se-cret」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Somehow, I'm starting to get a little nervous」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. I was slacking off too, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Still nervous?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... I even ran away and all」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine」
I took hold of Nanaka's hand.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. It'll be fine」
For a brief moment, she squeezes back tightly, and our hands part.

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry I'm late!」

name: Ria
message: 「Welcome back」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Welcome baaack」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, slacking off on Holy Night Festival preparations when you're the Student Council President is the absolute worst!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, even without Sakura-kun here, everything's fine as long as I'm around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look who's talking, Madam Vice President. Weren't you the one worrying the most, wondering when he'd get back?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's! Well! Keeping track of the President's whereabouts is the Vice President's duty!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's not like I did anything special, I was just fulfilling my duties! Besides, I was only worried about the phone I left with you!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez. Just because you wanna be a delinquent doesn't mean you can skip out.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san. Skipping out is precisely what makes a delinquent a delinquent.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone. I'm sorry. And, thank you.」
Nanaka bowed her head deeply.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm so sorry for making you worry!」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to apologize. Given the circumstances--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria. Proper closure is necessary.」

name: Ria
message: 「But, Akane-chan, you probably don't know, yet Nanaka-chan had her reasons...」
There's no way this person doesn't know. After all, she's been watching.
Even so, the reason she's saying this is...

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's a fact that this person caused us a whole heap of trouble.」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan, you offered to help out ages ago--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep. I helped out tons~ Worth a hundred people~」

name: Misa
message: 「It looked like you were just eating snacks, though.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well yeah, mostly on the eating side~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Frustratingly enough, because I was actually working, I lost to her.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the kind of contest it's fine to lose, man.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If she were the type of person with the nerve to cause trouble for others and not even say thank you or sorry, I wouldn't say a word.」
I see.
So she's doing this to make sure Nanaka doesn't let it weigh on her later.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I ran away on my own... just assuming nobody would believe me... I'm sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I jumped to conclusions all by myself and caused trouble for everyone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm sorry!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good grief, Nana-chan really is hopeless without me around~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I don't really want to hear that from you」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, since the real specialist is back, I think I'll be taking a breather soon」

name: Ria
message: 「Good work out there」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Think nothing of it. After all, I'll be having Rii-a pay me back plenty with her body」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Her body?!」

name: Ria
message: 「We promised to be partners for the final dance」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And Nanaka-san, here you go」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「These are the documents I worked on in your place」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa... t-there's this much?!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm no professional accountant, so if there are any mistakes, they're on your head」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For this time... th-thanks」

name: Misasagi
message: 「See you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, I've got something to hand over too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've got a bad feeling about this...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Here's the receipt for the cakes I brought as a treat~ I fronted the money for you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who decided to bring them!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nuh-uh~ I picked up radio waves from Nana-chan~ Telling me to go buy some sweets~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It specifically said 'sweets,' so it had to be Nana-chan's radio waves~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, I'm amazed you could eat in that situation」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, I knew Synn would definitely find Nana-chan! So I wasn't worried at all!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, like feeling safe on a bamboo-leaf boat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck is that supposed to mean?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're supposed to say a mud boat there」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, I'm heading over to my club too! See ya later!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, hold on!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Still, well, Sacchin helped out in her own way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nearly half of the snack cakes we brought ended up in Sacchin's stomach, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-She helped out, alright!」

name: Sally
message: 「And the other half went to me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't fall behind on eating them either」

name: Ria
message: 「So, Synn. We have all this paperwork here」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」
Right there stood a tower of documents!

name: Misa
message: 「And these too」
It doubled?!

name: Helena
message: 「Before we approve those documents, we have one job to do!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san, where were you hiding?! Wait, th-the tower?!」
Paying no mind to me frantically bracing the tower to keep it from toppling, Helena puffed out her chest,

name: Helena
message: 「Ria. Do you know what time it is?」

name: Ria
message: 「Right now... it's 4:02 AM」

name: Helena
message: 「Which means we have 21 minutes until Re-Crea begins and gets in the way of the Holy Night Festival」

name: Misa
message: 「'Gets in the way of the Holy Night Festival'... Isn't that way too small-scale of a description?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There isn't enough excitement」

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine. Saying it like this isn't wrong either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if someone talks about the end of the world, it doesn't feel real, does it」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, it doesn't\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「Besides, Lolotte-chan, the Holy Night Festival is the only thing we need to get excited about」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. That is certainly true」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, members of the Crusaders! Move out!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes!」

name: Helena
message: 「Wrap it up nice and quick♪」
